fidelity: F2a — WGS Reactor Kinetics + Physical-Solvent Absorber ODE
source: Moe (1962) CEP 58:33 (WGS Keq); Kohl & Nielsen (1997) Gas Purification 5th ed., Ch.14 (Selexol/Rectisol physical absorption, Henry's law); Smith et al. (2010) Chem.Eng.Res.Des. 88:1 (WGS LT-shift kinetics); IPCC (2005) SRCCS Ch.3 (pre-combustion energy penalty); Kunze & Spliethoff (2012) Appl.Energy 94:109.

unit.name: IGCC LT-shift WGS reactor + Selexol absorber — physics-lumped

k0_WGS.note: Pre-exponential forward WGS rate (lumped LT Cu/Zn shift catalyst bed, calibrated so the reactor approaches equilibrium within the design residence time, Smith 2010)

Ea_WGS.note: WGS forward apparent activation energy, low-temperature Cu/Zn shift (Smith et al. 2010)

tau_WGS_s.note: WGS reactor gas residence time (space time, V_bed/Q at operating T,P)

T_WGS_K.note: Nominal WGS bed temperature (250 degC, LT-shift window 200-300 degC)

henry_CO2_molperm3bar.note: CO2 solubility in Selexol/DEPG at ~25 degC: ~0.155 mol/(m3.Pa)*... -> ~155 mol/m3 per bar CO2 partial pressure (Kohl & Nielsen 1997, Selexol ~3-9x CO2 solubility of water)

henry_H2_molperm3bar.note: H2 solubility in Selexol (very low — physical solvent selective for CO2, Kohl & Nielsen 1997)

dH_sol_CO2.note: Heat of physical absorption of CO2 in DEPG (van't Hoff temperature correction of Henry coefficient)

KLa_absorber.note: Volumetric gas-liquid mass-transfer coefficient for CO2 in packed Selexol absorber (lumped)

L_over_G.note: Solvent-to-gas molar ratio in absorber (lean Selexol circulation)

T_abs_K.note: Absorber operating temperature (~25 degC, chilled physical solvent)

E_pump_GJ_tCO2.note: Solvent circulation pumping + flash regeneration parasitic (physical solvent, low — IPCC 2005 / Kunze 2012)

E_compression_GJ_tCO2.note: CO2 compression to 110 bar pipeline pressure (multistage, ~0.33 GJ/tCO2 from elevated capture P)
